upstream.name: sddai/markerPDF
upstream.architecture: Python PDF-to-Markdown extraction pipeline using pdftext, pypdfium2, Surya OCR/layout models, table/equation/image extraction, and Markdown post-processing.

benchmarkDenominator.total: 61 targeted upstream lane-relevant paths inspected from the cloned repository (workflows, benchmark/scoring scripts, committed example outputs, cleaner/postprocessor/layout/OCR/image/equation/table/output/settings/schema/source modules, and support scripts), plus 6 README benchmark document identifiers; 0 committed Python unit test files found
benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow upstream clone at .upstream-cache/markerpdf plus git ls-tree inventory of 61 targeted workflow/benchmark/example/source/support paths and targeted reads of README.md, .github/workflows/tests.yml, benchmarks/overall.py, marker/benchmark/scoring.py, marker/benchmark/table.py, scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py, marker/pdf/extract_text.py, marker/pdf/utils.py, marker/postprocessors/markdown.py, marker/cleaners/*.py, marker/layout/order.py, marker/ocr/heuristics.py, marker/ocr/utils.py, marker/ocr/lang.py, marker/ocr/tesseract.py, marker/images/save.py, marker/images/extract.py, marker/schema/block.py, marker/schema/bbox.py, marker/schema/merged.py, marker/schema/page.py, marker/equations/equations.py, marker/equations/inference.py, marker/tables/table.py, marker/tables/utils.py, marker/output.py, marker/settings.py, and data/examples/*/*.md paths. The Surya language-code boundary was cross-checked against the locked surya-ocr 0.6.13 wheel hash from poetry.lock (94 code entries). The mapped surrogate fixtures sample README-linked committed output pairs for multicolcnn.pdf, switch_trans.pdf, thinkpython.pdf, and thinkos.pdf from data/examples/marker/*.md and data/examples/nougat/*.md.
benchmarkDenominator.ciAssertionSource: scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py checks multicolcnn.pdf > 0.34 and switch_trans.pdf > 0.40 for marker output, plus average table score >= 0.7 for table reports.
benchmarkDenominator.runnerBlocker: The upstream CI benchmark downloads benchmark_data from Google Drive and requires Poetry plus heavy Python dependencies including torch, surya-ocr, pdftext, pypdfium2, tabled-pdf, Texify, and model downloads. The shallow clone contains no benchmark PDFs or references, so the full runner cannot execute locally under the modest network/CPU constraint.

marker.tables.table format_tables post-recognition branch removes intersecting Table layout blocks and inserts supplied Markdown table blocks at upstream insertion points before WordPress table rendering.
marker.cleaners.bullets replace_bullets converts upstream bullet glyphs to Markdown list markers.
marker.cleaners.text cleanup_text collapses excessive blank space and normalizes non-breaking spaces.
marker.cleaners.fontstyle find_bold_italic detects bold/italic spans from font names and font weights while skipping heading font-name bias.
marker.postprocessors.markdown surround_text and the styled-span branch of merge_spans emit upstream-style Markdown emphasis markers with the first/last-span guard.
README-linked multicolcnn Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as an upstream-derived surrogate pair while the external benchmark_data archive remains unavailable.
README-linked switch_trans Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as a second upstream-derived surrogate pair and checked against the upstream switch_trans CI threshold boundary.
marker.cleaners.headers filter_common_elements and filter_header_footer repeated edge-line detection remove common PDF page headers/footers after the upstream three-page minimum.
marker.cleaners.headers replace_leading_trailing_digits, find_overlap_elements, and filter_common_titles remove repeated numbered titles before WordPress block rendering.
README-linked thinkpython Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as a third upstream-derived surrogate pair while the external benchmark_data archive remains unavailable.
README-linked thinkos Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as a fourth upstream-derived surrogate pair while the external benchmark_data archive remains unavailable.
marker.cleaners.code is_code_linelen and comment_count heuristics detect code-like PDF lines from short alphanumeric line ratios and upstream-supported comment prefixes.
marker.cleaners.code identify_code_blocks indentation/comment majority and optional small-font checks classify code blocks before WordPress block rendering.
marker.cleaners.code indent_blocks reconstructs indentation from PDF line geometry and suppresses repeated blank lines before code block output.
marker.cleaners.headings split_heading_blocks separates detected heading lines from Text blocks when layout boxes overlap above the upstream threshold.
marker.cleaners.headings bucket_headings and infer_heading_levels assign heading levels from clustered line heights with the upstream default-level fallback.
marker.cleaners.toc compute_toc emits title, level, and page metadata for Title and Section-header blocks before WordPress table-of-contents rendering.
marker.postprocessors.markdown merge_lines groups MergedBlocks across block-type and heading-level boundaries before final Markdown rendering.
marker.postprocessors.markdown merge_lines uses equal-height, same-x, close-vertical-gap line geometry as a continuation hint for ambiguous extracted lines.
marker.postprocessors.markdown block_separator and get_full_text assemble final Markdown with Text-block paragraph spacing and optional page-start markers for paginated imports.
marker.pdf.utils sort_block_group sorts blocks into vertical tolerance buckets and then horizontally within each row.

marker.layout.order sort_blocks_in_reading_order assigns blocks to Surya ordering positions by maximum bbox overlap, appends unordered blocks, and pins page headers before footers for WordPress two-column imports.
marker.ocr.utils alphanum_ratio removes spaces/newlines and measures garbled OCR character quality.
marker.ocr.heuristics detect_bad_ocr flags empty text, excessive whitespace/newlines, low alphanumeric ratio, and repeated replacement characters.
marker.ocr.heuristics no_text_found detects all-empty documents before full-document OCR fallback.
marker.ocr.heuristics detected_line_coverage rescales Surya-detected line boxes and checks extracted-line intersection coverage.
marker.ocr.heuristics should_ocr_page combines no-text, bad-OCR, line-coverage, and force-OCR flags before WordPress import.
marker.ocr.lang replace_langs_with_codes maps Surya OCR language names to pinned Surya language codes while preserving already-coded inputs.
marker.ocr.lang replace_langs_with_codes maps OCRmyPDF/Tesseract language names to Tesseract codes and supplies Marker's default language when metadata omits languages.
marker.ocr.lang validate_langs rejects invalid Surya and Tesseract engine-specific codes before WordPress OCR handoff.
marker.ocr.tesseract LANGUAGE_TO_TESSERACT_CODE is represented natively for multilingual OCR metadata preflight.
marker.images.save get_image_filename generates deterministic page-indexed PNG filenames for extracted images.
marker.images.save images_to_dict exports page image payloads keyed by upstream filename while skipping pages with no images.
marker.schema.block find_insert_block selects the nearest block by top-left distance for image regions with no detected text lines.
marker.images.extract find_image_blocks rescales Figure/Picture layout boxes, clears intersecting text spans, and records insertion line positions.

marker.images.extract extract_page_images inserts upstream Markdown image spans into existing or newly-created lines before WordPress image-block rendering; native PHP supplies placeholder payloads because upstream raster rendering depends on pypdfium/PIL.

marker.equations.equations find_equation_blocks rescales Formula layout boxes, removes intersecting text lines, falls back to the nearest block when detected lines are missing, and enforces the upstream Texify model token cap at the native boundary.
marker.equations.equations increment_insert_points shifts later insertion block indexes after Formula blocks are inserted.

marker.equations.equations insert_latex_block validates supplied LaTeX predictions, inserts Formula blocks before, after, or inside split text blocks, and preserves original equation text when validation fails.
marker.equations.equations replace_equations reports successful_ocr, unsuccessful_ocr, and equations metadata for the converted document.

marker.equations.inference get_total_texify_tokens and prediction max-length guards are represented with a deterministic native token-count boundary; full Texify tokenizer/model inference remains unported.
marker.postprocessors.markdown Formula block_surround and line_separator preserve accepted LaTeX display-math fences after replacement for WordPress math block rendering.
marker.tables.utils sort_table_blocks groups recognized table cells into vertical row buckets and sorts each row left-to-right before WordPress table rendering.
marker.tables.utils replace_dots removes long dot leaders from table cell text while preserving short ellipses.
marker.tables.utils replace_newlines collapses table cell line breaks to spaces before Gutenberg table output.
marker.output get_subfolder_path derives per-document output directories from the final filename extension.
marker.output get_markdown_filepath derives the converted Markdown path inside the per-document output directory.
marker.output markdown_exists checks whether a converted Markdown artifact is already present.
marker.output save_markdown writes Markdown, metadata JSON, and PNG image artifacts for downstream WordPress import handoff.
marker.settings default scalar/list constants are exposed natively for the PDF conversion pipeline.
marker.settings SUPPORTED_FILETYPES maps application/pdf to pdf and rejects unsupported WordPress import MIME types.
marker.settings TORCH_DEVICE_MODEL falls back to cpu when no explicit device is supplied at the native boundary.
marker.settings CUDA, MODEL_DTYPE, and TEXIFY_DTYPE computed properties are represented without importing Torch.
marker.settings pydantic environment overrides are represented with typed native coercion for booleans, integers, floats, arrays, and strings.
marker.settings Config extra=ignore behavior is represented by ignoring unknown override keys.
marker.settings OCR_ENGINE Literal boundary accepts surya and ocrmypdf and rejects unsupported values.
marker.settings PAGE_SEPARATOR, BAD_SPAN_TYPES, OCR, pagination, and image-extraction flags drive a WordPress PDF import preflight.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 65 focused upstream source semantics plus four committed upstream-derived benchmark surrogate pairs; no external upstream benchmark PDF/reference archive pair is mapped yet because the external benchmark_data archive was not fetched. Table formatting maps the post-recognition insertion boundary with supplied Markdown tables, and table utilities map row ordering plus dot/newline cleanup, but detection/recognition still depends on upstream tabled/Surya models. Equation replacement maps Marker structural semantics at the native boundary, but Texify model inference and PDF equation raster rendering remain unported. Output artifact persistence, settings preflight, and OCR language-code normalization now map marker/output.py, marker/settings.py, marker/ocr/lang.py, and marker/ocr/tesseract.py at native boundaries, but full upstream conversion still depends on pdftext/pypdfium/Surya/Texify/tabled.
